title: Durion Positivity Frontend Site Map
description: Machine-readable index of the frontend's navigable sections, published as the read-only /sitemap.json build artifact and consumed by pos-mcp-server. Versioned; bump `version` on breaking shape changes.

version.description: Contract version of the site-map shape.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this artifact was generated (per build).

titleKey.description: i18n key for the section title (SHELL.NAV.*).

title.description: Section title resolved to the base locale (en-US).

descriptionKey.description: i18n key for the section description (SITEMAP.SECTIONS.*).

description.description: Section description resolved to the base locale (en-US).

roles.description: Roles required to access the section; absent = all authenticated users.

group.description: Grouping of the section. Groups are ordered main before admin; sections[] is serialized by (group, order).

order.description: Sort order within the section's group (lower sorts earlier).
